reviewStatus: Root selected V6 after independent complete heavy sequence and actual browser hand/character closeup review; overhead lift/downward cut coherent, no hood crossing. Runtime gameplay check follows. Forearm bound produces a shallower blade finish.
limitations: Video extraction omits root travel; roll surface travel and hit fixed-camera translation reconstructed.
Heavy weapon orientation follows measured reference blade angles; body remains captured, forearm pronation/wrist flex corrected.
Approved mesh and equipment retained; detailed armor contact still requires rendered review.

shieldMount.source: scripts/solve-shield-mount.mjs (SHIELD_DROP=.2) on idle 1.0 s: face normal follows the fist's heading pitched 18 degrees up (the fist itself points 43 degrees up), height axis upright, centre 9 cm in front of the fist and 20 cm down the shield's height axis so the top sits at chin height. Replaces the along-the-forearm mount at 0.73 m.

tuck.note: During the forward roll the shield blends back to the legacy along-the-forearm orientation (shieldTuckWeight in src/game/actors.js), raised 10 cm along the socket Y axis; the props audit then shows 3 mm of floor overlap at 0.32 s instead of 37 cm with the guard mount held.

runtimeAdjustments.facingYawDegrees: The captured guard family has the body square to camera and the head turned 35 degrees to the model's left (pose-inspection.json). idle, block, hit and light turn the visual root -35 degrees, blended by animation weight, so the gaze and the bladed stance face the opponent without editing the GLB. The overhead heavy stays at 0 and squares up through its 0.12 s blend: scripts/sweep-player-stance-yaw.mjs shows the narrow chop misses a target straight ahead at any other yaw, while the light cut reaches it more often at -35 (17/23 samples) than at 0 (10/23). Locomotion, heal and dodge stay at 0.
runtimeAdjustments.smoothBones: A captured left-hand twitch at 0.65-0.70 s (292 deg/s, median 18) is removed by a loop-aware 0.6 s Gaussian on the left arm chain in idle and block.
